sql: WITH live AS (SELECT market_ticker, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, period_reward_usd / greatest(extract(epoch FROM (end_date - start_date)) / 86400.0, 0.04) AS pool_day, end_date FROM incentive_programs WHERE coalesce(incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%' AND superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND end_date > now() AND start_date <= now()), snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at > now() - interval '2 hours') SELECT series, count(*) AS markets, round(sum(pool_day)::numeric,0) AS pool_day, round(max(pool_day)::numeric,1) AS max_mkt_pool_day, min(end_date)::date AS ends FROM live WHERE market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM snap) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15
